---
title: "Explorable: Break the Philosophers"
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

All 1,374 philosophers, laid out so Louvain's communities sit apart. Drag **alpha** down to
tighten the disparity-filter backbone and watch the giant component (bright) come apart from
everything else (faded). **Click a philosopher to delete them** and see who gets stranded; try
Aristotle at alpha around 0.03, then Erasmus at 0.047. Companion piece to [Week 4's
post](/posts/2026-week4-aristotle-is-the-seam/).

```{=html}
<div id="phil-explorable">
  <style>
    #phil-explorable { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; max-width: 1000px; margin: 1rem 0; color: #212529; }
    #phil-explorable .controls { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem 1.5rem; align-items: center; padding: 1rem; background: #f7f7f9; border: 1px solid #e3e3e6; border-radius: 8px; }
    #phil-explorable .controls label { font-weight: 600; margin-right: .4rem; }
    #phil-explorable input[type=range] { width: 260px; accent-color: #c8102e; }
    #phil-explorable select, #phil-explorable button { font-size: .9rem; padding: .35rem .6rem; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #c9c9cf; background: #fff; }
    #phil-explorable button { background: #c8102e; color: #fff; border: none; cursor: pointer; }
    #phil-explorable button:hover { background: #a00d25; }
    #phil-explorable .val { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 700; display: inline-block; min-width: 3.6em; }
    #phil-explorable .stats { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: .8rem 0; font-size: .95rem; }
    #phil-explorable .stats b { font-size: 1.25rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    #phil-explorable .stage { position: relative; }
    #phil-explorable canvas { width: 100%; height: auto; aspect-ratio: 1000 / 720; border: 1px solid #e3e3e6; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; display: block; cursor: crosshair; }
    #phil-explorable .tip { position: absolute; pointer-events: none; background: rgba(27,27,27,.92); color: #fff; padding: .3rem .55rem; border-radius: 5px; font-size: .8rem; display: none; white-space: nowrap; }
    #phil-explorable .legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .3rem 1rem; font-size: .8rem; margin-top: .6rem; }
    #phil-explorable .legend span::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: .7em; height: .7em; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--c); margin-right: .35em; }
    #phil-explorable .removed { font-size: .9rem; margin-top: .5rem; min-height: 1.4em; }
    #phil-explorable .err { color: #c8102e; font-weight: 600; }
  </style>

  <div class="controls">
    <div><label for="pe-alpha">alpha</label><input id="pe-alpha" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="37"><span class="val" id="pe-alpha-val"></span></div>
    <div><label for="pe-color">colour by</label>
      <select id="pe-color">
        <option value="louvain">Louvain</option>
        <option value="louvainW">Louvain (weighted)</option>
        <option value="infomap">Infomap</option>
        <option value="era">era</option>
      </select></div>
    <button id="pe-reset">Restore everyone</button>
  </div>
  <div class="stats">
    <div>links kept <b id="pe-edges">–</b></div>
    <div>giant component <b id="pe-giant">–</b></div>
    <div>stranded by your removals <b id="pe-stranded">0</b></div>
  </div>
  <div class="stage"><canvas id="pe-canvas" width="1000" height="720"></canvas><div class="tip" id="pe-tip"></div></div>
  <div class="removed" id="pe-removed"></div>
  <div class="legend" id="pe-legend"></div>

  <script>
  (async function () {
    const root = document.getElementById("phil-explorable");
    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    let D;
    try {
      const r = await fetch("philosophers.json");
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
      D = await r.json();
    } catch (e) {
      $("pe-removed").innerHTML = '<span class="err">Could not load philosophers.json (' + e.message + ').</span>';
      return;
    }
    const N = D.names.length, E = D.edges;
    const PAL = ["#c8102e","#4c72b0","#55a868","#dd8452","#8172b3","#937860","#da8bc3","#8c8c8c","#ccb974","#64b5cd"];
    const W = 1000, H = 720, PAD = 30;
    const xs = D.x, ys = D.y;
    const x0 = Math.min(...xs), x1 = Math.max(...xs), y0 = Math.min(...ys), y1 = Math.max(...ys);
    const sc = Math.min((W - 2 * PAD) / (x1 - x0), (H - 2 * PAD) / (y1 - y0));
    const px = xs.map(v => PAD + (v - x0) * sc + ((W - 2 * PAD) - (x1 - x0) * sc) / 2);
    const py = ys.map(v => PAD + (v - y0) * sc + ((H - 2 * PAD) - (y1 - y0) * sc) / 2);
    const ARI = D.names.indexOf("Aristotle");

    const removed = new Set();
    let alpha = 1, colorKey = "louvain", hover = -1;

    // slider position (0..100) -> alpha on a log scale from 0.6 down to 0.005
    const sliderToAlpha = v => 0.6 * Math.pow(0.005 / 0.6, v / 100);
    const alphaToSlider = a => 100 * Math.log(a / 0.6) / Math.log(0.005 / 0.6);

    function components(keep) {
      const parent = new Int32Array(N).map((_, i) => i), size = new Int32Array(N).fill(1);
      const find = x => { while (parent[x] !== x) { parent[x] = parent[parent[x]]; x = parent[x]; } return x; };
      for (const i of keep) {
        const a = find(E[i][0]), b = find(E[i][1]);
        if (a !== b) { if (size[a] < size[b]) { parent[a] = b; size[b] += size[a]; } else { parent[b] = a; size[a] += size[b]; } }
      }
      return { find, size };
    }

    function compute() {
      const keep = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < E.length; i++)
        if (E[i][2] < alpha && !removed.has(E[i][0]) && !removed.has(E[i][1])) keep.push(i);
      const { find, size } = components(keep);
      let best = -1, bestSize = 0;
      for (const i of keep) for (const n of [E[i][0], E[i][1]]) { const r = find(n); if (size[r] > bestSize) { bestSize = size[r]; best = r; } }
      const inGiant = new Uint8Array(N);
      for (const i of keep) for (const n of [E[i][0], E[i][1]]) if (find(n) === best) inGiant[n] = 1;
      const hasEdge = new Uint8Array(N);
      for (const i of keep) { hasEdge[E[i][0]] = 1; hasEdge[E[i][1]] = 1; }
      return { keep, inGiant, hasEdge, giant: bestSize };
    }

    function colorOf(i) {
      if (colorKey === "era") return PAL[D.era[i] % PAL.length];
      return PAL[D[colorKey][i] % PAL.length];
    }

    function legend() {
      const names = colorKey === "era" ? D.eraNames : D[colorKey + "Names"];
      const n = Math.min(names.length, PAL.length);
      $("pe-legend").innerHTML = names.slice(0, n).map((nm, k) => '<span style="--c:' + PAL[k] + '">' + (colorKey === "era" ? nm : nm + " group") + "</span>").join("");
    }

    const ctx = $("pe-canvas").getContext("2d");
    let state;
    function draw() {
      state = compute();
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.4; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.035)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (const [a, b] of E) { if (removed.has(a) || removed.has(b)) continue; ctx.moveTo(px[a], py[a]); ctx.lineTo(px[b], py[b]); }
      ctx.stroke();
      // kept links: non-giant faded, giant bright
      ctx.lineWidth = 0.7; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(120,120,120,0.55)"; ctx.beginPath();
      for (const i of state.keep) { const [a, b] = E[i]; if (state.inGiant[a]) continue; ctx.moveTo(px[a], py[a]); ctx.lineTo(px[b], py[b]); }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.1; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(200,16,46,0.75)"; ctx.beginPath();
      for (const i of state.keep) { const [a, b] = E[i]; if (!state.inGiant[a]) continue; ctx.moveTo(px[a], py[a]); ctx.lineTo(px[b], py[b]); }
      ctx.stroke();
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        if (removed.has(i)) continue;
        const g = state.inGiant[i], on = state.hasEdge[i];
        ctx.globalAlpha = g ? 1 : on ? 0.75 : 0.22;
        ctx.fillStyle = colorOf(i);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px[i], py[i], 1.6 + Math.sqrt(D.deg[i]) * (g ? 0.42 : 0.3), 0, 6.283); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      for (const i of removed) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#000"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px[i] - 5, py[i] - 5); ctx.lineTo(px[i] + 5, py[i] + 5); ctx.moveTo(px[i] + 5, py[i] - 5); ctx.lineTo(px[i] - 5, py[i] + 5); ctx.stroke();
      }
      // label the biggest hubs that are in the giant
      ctx.font = "600 11px -apple-system, sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center";
      const boxes = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < N && boxes.length < 12; i++) {
        if (removed.has(i) || !state.inGiant[i]) continue;
        const w = ctx.measureText(D.names[i]).width + 4, bx = px[i] - w / 2, by = py[i] - 21;
        if (boxes.some(o => bx < o[0] + o[2] && bx + w > o[0] && by < o[1] + 13 && by + 13 > o[1])) continue;
        boxes.push([bx, by, w]);
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)"; ctx.fillRect(bx, by, w, 13);
        ctx.fillStyle = "#111"; ctx.fillText(D.names[i], px[i], py[i] - 11);
      }
      if (hover >= 0 && !removed.has(hover)) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "#000"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px[hover], py[hover], 7, 0, 6.283); ctx.stroke();
      }
      $("pe-edges").textContent = state.keep.length.toLocaleString();
      $("pe-giant").textContent = state.giant;
      $("pe-alpha-val").textContent = alpha.toFixed(3);
      if (removed.size) {
        const rem = [...removed];
        $("pe-stranded").textContent = strandedCount();
        $("pe-removed").innerHTML = "Removed: " + rem.map(i => "<b>" + D.names[i] + "</b>").join(", ") + " (click a cross to restore).";
      } else { $("pe-stranded").textContent = "0"; $("pe-removed").textContent = "Click any philosopher to delete them."; }
    }

    // giant component as it would be with nobody removed, at the current alpha
    function withoutRemovals() {
      const keep = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < E.length; i++) if (E[i][2] < alpha) keep.push(i);
      const { find, size } = components(keep);
      let bestSize = 0, best = -1;
      for (const i of keep) for (const n of [E[i][0], E[i][1]]) { const r = find(n); if (size[r] > bestSize) { bestSize = size[r]; best = r; } }
      const inG = new Uint8Array(N);
      for (const i of keep) for (const n of [E[i][0], E[i][1]]) if (find(n) === best) inG[n] = 1;
      return { giant: bestSize, inG };
    }
    // philosophers who were in the intact giant, are not removed, and are no longer in it
    function strandedCount() {
      const base = withoutRemovals();
      let c = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) if (base.inG[i] && !removed.has(i) && !state.inGiant[i]) c++;
      return c;
    }

    function nearest(mx, my, maxD) {
      let best = -1, bd = maxD * maxD;
      for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) { const d = (px[i] - mx) ** 2 + (py[i] - my) ** 2; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = i; } }
      return best;
    }
    function canvasXY(ev) {
      const r = $("pe-canvas").getBoundingClientRect();
      return [(ev.clientX - r.left) * W / r.width, (ev.clientY - r.top) * H / r.height, ev.clientX - r.left, ev.clientY - r.top];
    }
    $("pe-canvas").addEventListener("mousemove", ev => {
      const [mx, my, sx, sy] = canvasXY(ev);
      const h = nearest(mx, my, 9);
      const tip = $("pe-tip");
      if (h !== hover) { hover = h; draw(); }
      if (h >= 0) { tip.style.display = "block"; tip.style.left = (sx + 12) + "px"; tip.style.top = (sy + 12) + "px";
        tip.textContent = D.names[h] + " · " + D.deg[h] + " links · " + D.eraNames[D.era[h]]; }
      else tip.style.display = "none";
    });
    $("pe-canvas").addEventListener("mouseleave", () => { hover = -1; $("pe-tip").style.display = "none"; draw(); });
    $("pe-canvas").addEventListener("click", ev => {
      const [mx, my] = canvasXY(ev);
      const h = nearest(mx, my, 9);
      if (h < 0) return;
      removed.has(h) ? removed.delete(h) : removed.add(h);
      draw();
    });
    $("pe-alpha").addEventListener("input", ev => { alpha = sliderToAlpha(+ev.target.value); draw(); });
    $("pe-color").addEventListener("change", ev => { colorKey = ev.target.value; legend(); draw(); });
    $("pe-reset").addEventListener("click", () => { removed.clear(); draw(); });

    alpha = sliderToAlpha(+$("pe-alpha").value);
    legend(); draw();
  })();
  </script>
</div>
```
